title: Craftable nametagg
description: This datapack add craft for nametag with 1 iron nugget and 1 paper
body:
This Datapack craft name tag for minecraft in survival 1.21.7-1.21.8 
How to craft -> 1 iron nugget and 1 paper.
The datapack is ideal if you want to name many animals but don't want to buy each tag at 20 emeralds.
